text: DSH Mermaid 是一款 DSH Web 和 Desktop 插件，可把会话中的 Mermaid 代码块渲染成可交互图表。客户端识别代码块，并从 DSH 同源路由按需加载内置 Mermaid 运行时。用户可以切换代码与图形、全屏缩放和拖动画布、下载 SVG；插件也适配流式回复、深浅主题和中英文界面。适合在阅读技术讨论或工作流时查看图表。无需额外 API Key 或账号。

DSH Mermaid renders Mermaid code blocks as diagrams in DSH chats. It loads the bundled runtime from a same-origin route. Users can switch views, zoom and pan fullscreen, and download SVG files. It supports streamed replies and English or Simplified Chinese controls.

DSH Mermaid 的功能「代码块识别与渲染」：识别 mermaid、mermaidjs、mmd 围栏代码块，并将 Mermaid 源码渲染为 SVG；无语言标记时也识别已知图类型。
DSH Mermaid 的功能「视图切换」：每张图表卡片提供代码和图形按钮，用户可随时切换；视图变化时尽量维持会话中的阅读位置。
DSH Mermaid 的功能「全屏浏览」：全屏查看器支持滚轮缩放、拖动平移、适应窗口或重置到 100%；按 Esc 或关闭按钮退出。
DSH Mermaid 的功能「SVG 导出」：图表成功渲染后，点击下载按钮即可把当前 SVG 序列化并保存为独立文件，文件名包含图表类型。
DSH Mermaid 的功能「流式回复适配」：观察会话 DOM 中新增或变化的代码块，延迟并串行安排渲染；过期结果会被忽略，源码清空或组件卸载时会清理卡片。
DSH Mermaid 的功能「主题与语言适配」：跟随 DSH 深浅主题渲染图表，并依据页面和浏览器语言显示英文或简体中文控件及状态提示。
DSH Mermaid 使用前须知：单个 Mermaid 源码超过 50,000 个字符或 2,000 行时会被拒绝渲染；发生渲染错误时显示源码视图。

Render Mermaid code blocks as interactive SVG diagrams in **DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop**. Switch between source and diagram, explore large diagrams in fullscreen, and export SVG files without leaving the conversation.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mermaid)

An English pull request workflow rendered in a DSH conversation. [View the Mermaid source](docs/examples/pull-request-workflow.mmd).

dsh-mermaid README · Quick start：Requires DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and **Node.js 22.19 or later**. Commands below use Windows PowerShell; on macOS or Linux, use `npx` and `npm` in place of `npx.cmd` and `npm.cmd`.

dsh-mermaid README · 1. Install：With a global `dsh` command, install the npm release into your Web profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-mermaid
```

If `dsh` is not on your PATH, invoke it through npx:

```powershell
npx.cmd --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-mermaid
```

dsh-mermaid README · 1. Install：For **DSH Desktop**, replace `--profile web` with `--profile desktop`. DSH installs the package through pnpm and automatically registers its `dsh.bundle` declaration in the selected profile. Restart DSH Web or DSH Desktop after installation; for an already running Web session, refresh the browser page as well.

dsh-mermaid README · 2. Render a diagram：Ask a model to output a Mermaid fenced code block, for example:

````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Idea] --> B[Mermaid code]
  B --> C[Diagram]
  C --> D[SVG export]
```
````

The block opens in **Diagram** view by default. Use **Code / Diagram** to switch views. The plugin also recognizes `mermaidjs` and `mmd` fences; inline code is left unchanged.

dsh-mermaid README · 3. Explore and export：- **Fullscreen** opens a viewer with mouse-wheel zoom, dragging, 100% reset, and fit-to-window controls. Press `Esc` to close it.
- **Download SVG** saves the rendered diagram as a standalone file.
- Both actions remain available in Code view once a diagram has rendered successfully.

dsh-mermaid README · Features：- **Streaming support** — discovers new blocks as responses arrive and prevents older renders from replacing newer content.
- **Theme and language** — follows DSH's light/dark theme and uses English or Simplified Chinese based on the page and browser language.
- **Large-diagram viewing** — fullscreen zoom and pan, with a stable toolbar position when switching views.
- **Accessible controls** — keyboard focus management, render/download announcements, and accessible SVG names.
- **Bundled runtime** — pins Mermaid `11.17.0`, loads it on demand from DSH's own origin, and requires no runtime CDN. Multiple diagrams render through a serial queue.
- **Source fallback** — uses Mermaid's `securityLevel: strict` and returns to source on rendering errors. Diagrams exceeding 50,000 characters or 2,000 lines are rejected before rendering.

dsh-mermaid README · Update and uninstall：Run the command for your installed profile; replace `web` with `desktop` for DSH Desktop.

```powershell
dsh-mermaid README · Update the npm release：dsh plugin --profile web update -w dsh-mermaid

dsh-mermaid README · Uninstall：dsh plugin --profile web remove -w dsh-mermaid
```

If needed, replace the leading `dsh` with `npx.cmd --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh`. Restart the corresponding DSH application afterward and refresh any open Web page. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for release details.

dsh-mermaid README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| No Code / Diagram controls | Confirm that the plugin is installed in the profile you are using, restart DSH, and refresh the page. Use an explicit `mermaid` fenced block. |
| Source appears with an error | Check the Mermaid syntax and the displayed error. Split diagrams that exceed 50,000 characters or 2,000 lines. |
| Fullscreen or download is unavailable | These actions require a successfully rendered SVG. Resolve any rendering error first. |
| GitHub installation reports a blocked build script | Follow the build-script guidance under **Install from GitHub** below. |

dsh-mermaid README · Compatibility：The most recent UI check was on **2026-10-28**, using Windows / Chrome, `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.3` (Web profile), and `dsh-mermaid 0.4.4`. The DSH host ran on Node.js 24.21.0 bundled with DSH Desktop.

dsh-mermaid README · Compatibility：An isolated environment with a local example conversation confirmed English flowchart rendering, toolbar display, opening and closing fullscreen, and fullscreen panning. The screenshots above come from that environment. This was a UI smoke check; it did not cover a full feature regression or the native Desktop window.

dsh-mermaid README · Compatibility：DSH is a developer preview; newer versions may change its plugin loader or Markdown DOM. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid/issues), include your DSH, plugin, and Node.js versions, Web/Desktop profile, and a minimal Mermaid example. Remove private conversation content before sharing.

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：<details>
<summary>Install from GitHub</summary>

For normal use, prefer the npm release. To install the latest repository source, ensure a global `dsh` command is on your PATH, then run:

```powershell
npx.cmd -y github:MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid install
```

For DSH Desktop:

```powershell
npx.cmd -y github:MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid install --profile desktop
```

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：The repository installer asks DSH to install the GitHub source into the selected profile and builds the package during installation. If pnpm blocks a build script, add the exact package key shown by pnpm to `allowBuilds` in that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then run the command again. Restart the corresponding DSH application afterward.

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：The installer supports English and Simplified Chinese. It checks `DSH_MERMAID_LANG`, `DSH_LANG`, `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, `LANG`, and `LANGUAGE` in that order, then uses the system language; neutral `C`/`POSIX` values are skipped. Set `DSH_MERMAID_LANG=en` or `DSH_MERMAID_LANG=zh-CN` to override the choice. This affects the installer’s own messages, independently of the browser interface, DSH, and pnpm.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Runtime and integration boundary</summary>

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：The Mermaid runtime runs in the DSH Web browser or Desktop renderer, where `window` and `document` are available. The Node.js host serves the bundled file over HTTP. The Node.js version requirement covers installation, builds, and the plugin host; this package does not currently provide a supported Node.js validation API.

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：`lib/mermaid-runtime.js` is an internal browser bundle. It is shipped for the plugin's same-origin runtime route and is not a public package export. Resolving `dsh-mermaid/package.json` and constructing a path to this file depends on internal packaging details that may change.

Integrators experimenting with server-side parsing must account for these requirements:

dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：- Some diagram parsers sanitize labels through DOMPurify during `parse()`. Without a DOM, valid labeled flowcharts and state diagrams can throw `addHook is not a function` or `sanitize is not a function`. Successful parsing of one sequence diagram does not establish compatibility for other inputs.
- Provide a compatible DOM **before the first runtime import**, preferably in a dedicated worker or process. DOMPurify captures its environment during initialization; adding a DOM after import does not repair the cached module. Temporarily assigning globals around an asynchronous import can also expose them to other host code. Follow [DOMPurify's server-side guidance](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify#running-dompurify-on-the-server) when choosing a DOM implementation.
- On Windows, convert an absolute filesystem path with `pathToFileURL(runtimePath).href` before passing it to dynamic `import()`.
- Distinguish invalid input from unavailable dependencies, environment failures, and timeouts. Mermaid's `.hash` error field is not a universal classifier: invalid pie syntax and unknown diagram types can also fail without it. An incomplete validation must no
dsh-mermaid README · Advanced usage：</details>

dsh-mermaid README · Development：From a local checkout, with Node.js 22.19 or later:

```powershell
npm.cmd install
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd run build
dsh plugin --profile web add -w .

Build output is written to `lib/`. The lightweight `client.js` bootstrap is registered with the DSH client module loader as `dsh-mermaid`; the bundled Mermaid runtime is served through the plugin's same-origin host route and loaded on demand. DSH resolves the relative installation path against the current plugin checkout.

dsh-mermaid README · Development：`npm.cmd run check` runs syntax and client tests, builds the runtime, and tests its real parser in separate processes with and without a DOM. The DOM-backed parser tests use happy-dom as a test fixture; they do not verify browser layout or SVG rendering, or recommend a production server-side DOM implementation.

<details>
<summary>Manual installation for local development</summary>

The built package can also be copied to:

dsh-mermaid README · Development：```text
C:\Users\<username>\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-mermaid
```

Never commit the complete `.dsh` directory; it may contain conversations and credentials.

</details>

dsh-mermaid README · 功能特性：- **流式输出适配**：随回复发现新代码块，避免旧的异步渲染覆盖新内容。

- **内置运行时**：固定打包 Mermaid `11.17.0`，从 DSH 同源按需加载，不依赖运行时 CDN；多图通过串行队列渲染。
- **源码回退**：使用 Mermaid `securityLevel: strict`，渲染失败时显示源码；单图超过 50,000 字符或 2,000 行时，在渲染前拒绝处理。

dsh-mermaid README · 进阶使用：<details>
<summary>安装 GitHub 源码版</summary>

日常使用建议选择 npm 发布版。如需安装仓库最新源码，请先确保全局 `dsh` 命令在 PATH 中，再运行：

```powershell
npx.cmd -y github:MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid install
```

安装到 DSH Desktop：

```powershell
npx.cmd -y github:MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid install --profile desktop
```

仓库安装器会调用 DSH，把 GitHub 源安装到所选 profile，并在安装阶段构建。如果 pnpm 阻止了构建脚本，请把提示中的精确包名加入该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 中，再重新执行命令。完成后重启对应的 DSH 应用。

dsh-mermaid README · 进阶使用：安装器支持简体中文与英文，依次读取 `DSH_MERMAID_LANG`、`DSH_LANG`、`LC_ALL`、`LC_MESSAGES`、`LANG`、`LANGUAGE`，然后使用系统语言；跳过 `C`、`POSIX` 等中性区域值。可设置 `DSH_MERMAID_LANG=en` 或 `DSH_MERMAID_LANG=zh-CN` 覆盖。该设置只影响安装器自身文案，与浏览器界面、DSH 和 pnpm 的语言独立。

</details>

<details>
<summary>运行时与集成边界</summary>

Mermaid 运行时在 DSH Web 浏览器或 Desktop 渲染进程中执行，这些环境具有 `window` 和 `document`。Node.js 宿主通过 HTTP 提供打包文件。Node.js 版本要求适用于安装、构建和插件宿主；本项目目前未提供受支持的 Node.js 校验 API。

dsh-mermaid README · 进阶使用：`lib/mermaid-runtime.js` 是内部浏览器 bundle，随包发布是为了供插件的同源运行时路由使用，并非公开的包导出。通过解析 `dsh-mermaid/package.json` 再拼接路径访问此文件，会依赖可能变化的内部打包结构。

尝试在服务端复用解析器时，需要处理以下条件：

dsh-mermaid README · 进阶使用：- 部分图类型在 `parse()` 阶段就会通过 DOMPurify 清洗标签。缺少 DOM 时，合法的带标签 flowchart 和状态图也可能抛出 `addHook is not a function` 或 `sanitize is not a function`。某个时序图解析通过，不能证明其他输入也兼容。
- 在**首次导入运行时之前**提供兼容 DOM，建议放在独立 worker 或进程中。DOMPurify 会在初始化时捕获环境；导入后补 DOM 无法修复已缓存的模块。在异步导入期间临时修改全局变量，也可能被宿主的其他代码观察到。选择 DOM 实现时请参考 [DOMPurify 服务端说明](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify#running-dompurify-on-the-server)。
- Windows 上将绝对文件路径传入动态 `import()` 前，需要使用 `pathToFileURL(runtimePath).href` 转为文件 URL。
- 区分输入无效与依赖不可用、环境故障、超时等失败。Mermaid 错误的 `.hash` 字段不是通用分类依据：错误的 pie 语法、未知图类型也可能不带该字段。校验未完成时不能报告通过。
- 使用与渲染端一致的 Mermaid 版本及相关配置。`parse()` 通过仅表示语法检查通过，不能保证布局或 SVG 渲染成功；渲染端仍需保留错误处理和源码回退。
dsh-mermaid README · 进阶使用：</details>
